assets.title: A-Frame Sheet Storage Rack
assets.description: One original dual-ended A-frame sheet storage rack, counted as one fixed static prop including two inclined thick boards. Two flat-ground runners, four sloped uprights, two cross ties, two apex caps, two longitudinal beams and a central diagonal connect the two open end frames. Two full-length thick bottom bearers and toe stops hold the two original fixed boards. Each board has a horizontal bevel-cut bottom face and a short lower front shoulder giving complete finite opposed contact with its bearer and toe stop; its inclined back bears on two matching finite strips. All joints use opposed finite face patches, with actual empty space between the boards and inside each end frame. Twenty-three editable closed meshes; four opaque constant PBR materials; metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. No extra stock pile, saw, wheels, people, scene or animation. Static visual appearance only: no load capacity, strength, friction, stability, anti-tip, stock-size compatibility, loading access, ergonomics, manufacture, construction, installation or work-safety certification. No compatibility with historical sawhorse, pallet-rack, dish-rack or ladder interfaces is asserted.
